title: The entrance
steps: You and {friend} have just come in through the great door. The entrance hall is enormous and bright, with a thick red carpet and suits of armour shining in the torchlight. While night falls outside, the castle is warm and welcoming.
Welcome to Arvelia! I am Ilda, one of your teachers, and I look after all the first-year pupils.
As you saw at the gate, this castle listens to those who give it the right instructions. But it is very late to learn more magic tonight!
Wow, this place is so big and beautiful!
I cannot wait to see everything tomorrow!
Tomorrow will be a long day, so I will take you to the first-years' dormitory to rest now. Follow me, please.
The two of you follow Ilda across the hall, side by side, under a giant chandelier that shines like the stars.
It is not far at all, and your warm beds are waiting for you.
